items.title: What's left of communities in Nepal's disaster zones

children.content: More than a week on from the catastrophic Nepal floods, villages along the Bhotekoshi River remain completely isolated, including locations where Australians went missing.

The ABC crew has flown over and visited some of the worst-affected areas to see what is left.
